fragments.title: First memory of the ocean
fragments.summary: Salt air, sand, my grandmother's hand. The line where the world ended turned out to keep going.

fragments.title: Grandmother
fragments.summary: Knew the names of every plant. Read aloud at bedtime.

fragments.title: The cottage by the bay
fragments.summary: White paint, blue shutters, a screen door that slammed.

fragments.title: Childhood
fragments.summary: The years of small things mattering most.

fragments.title: First book that mattered
fragments.summary: Read it twice in a week. Started writing in margins.

fragments.title: The idea that the world is patterned
fragments.summary: That repeating shapes in nature aren't coincidence.

fragments.title: Best friend in middle school
fragments.summary: We made a code language. Half of it was just shrugs.

fragments.title: The treehouse
fragments.summary: Three planks and a rope. Held more secrets than any room since.

fragments.title: First time playing music in public
fragments.summary: Hands shook. Forgot the second verse. Got applause anyway.

fragments.title: Music
fragments.summary: That sound could carry feeling without translation.

fragments.title: High school
fragments.summary: Hallways. Crushes. Books I pretended to finish.

fragments.title: The teacher who saw me
fragments.summary: Wrote 'You can do this' on a returned essay. I kept the page.

fragments.title: Choosing a path
fragments.summary: Late-night decision. Picked the harder one.

fragments.title: University
fragments.summary: Coffee, all-nighters, the slow widening of the world.

fragments.title: Becoming an engineer
fragments.summary: Realizing I could build the things in my head.

fragments.title: First real project
fragments.summary: It almost worked. That was enough.

fragments.title: Lab partner
fragments.summary: Believed in the project before I did.

fragments.title: Moving to the city
fragments.summary: Boxes, freight elevator, takeout on the floor.

fragments.title: Apartment with the south window
fragments.summary: Light came in like it was paid to.

fragments.title: Long quiet years of work
fragments.summary: The unglamorous stretch where the actual learning happened.

fragments.title: The trip that changed me
fragments.summary: Two weeks. No phone. Came back lighter.

fragments.title: The mountain village
fragments.summary: Bread baked at four AM. Stars visible at six.

fragments.title: Building the first system that mattered
fragments.summary: It ran. People used it. I learned what shipping costs.

fragments.title: Privacy as a worldview
fragments.summary: That **ownership of your own data** is a precondition for *freedom*. Companion to [Amni-Scient](https://amni-scient.com).

fragments.title: The Amni-Scient ecosystem
fragments.summary: All the threads tying together into something coherent.
